description.en: Two or more distinct personality states with recurrent amnesia; disruption of identity characterized by marked discontinuity of sense of self and sense of agency.
description.hi: दो या अधिक भिन्न व्यक्तित्व-अवस्थाएँ एवं बार-बार क्षतिस्मृति; स्व-बोध एवं कर्तृत्व-बोध में स्पष्ट असंततता।

mappingNote: ICD-11 6B64 corresponds to DSM-5-TR Dissociative Identity Disorder; the pre-existing 'dissociative' key holds the same label and is retained for backward compatibility. Flagged by MID-60/DES-II screens only — diagnosis requires the full structured interview.
